collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager freezes on the canoe landing, staring through the gaps at deep water: ask a friend to walk ahead, or look up.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the canoe landing, the water under the wooden boards is deep and dark, and the boards have gaps between them. (subject) has walked across them a thousand times. Today, for no reason at all, (subject.he/she) has frozen in the middle, looking down through a gap into the dark water, unable to move. (friend) is behind (subject.him/her) with a load of fish.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Go ahead of me," says (subject). "I'll follow you." (friend) goes first, slowly, and (subject) keeps (subject.his/her) eyes on (friend)'s back instead of on the gaps. They reach the end. (subject) breathes out. (subject.He/she) doesn't know why today was different. Tomorrow it might not be.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) looks up, away from the gaps, at the sky and the trees and the gulls. (subject.He/she) walks to the end without looking down. (friend) follows. "You alright?" "Fine," says (subject). (subject.He/she) isn't, quite. (subject.He/she) is well enough to walk, and today that will do.
